model_name: Virtual EV LSTM Sequential Energy Predictor

architecture.non_negativity_formulation: Dense(1, activation='softplus') guarantees smooth, strictly non-negative physical energy predictions without clipping.

exact_target_definition.input_sequence_timesteps: t1 ... t20 (100 seconds observed driving history)
exact_target_definition.anti_leakage_guarantee: Strict chronological boundary: no future observations (t >= 21) appear in the input sequence (t1 ... t20).

experiment_A_tabular_trip_models.scope: Macroscopic whole-trip summary (1 row = 1 full trip of 2-65 km)

experiment_B_sequential_lstm_model.scope: Microscopic sliding telemetry window (20 steps = 100s driving history)

comparative_modeling_experiments.methodology_note: Tabular models and the LSTM model are distinct modeling experiments addressing different prediction granularities and horizons. They should not be combined into a single directly comparable leaderboard.

synthetic_data_disclosure: The LSTM model is trained and evaluated strictly on synthetic/simulated Virtual EV driving telemetry generated via the project's physics simulation architecture. Reported metrics reflect goodness-of-fit on this simulated distribution and do not constitute validated real-world physical EV measurements.
